items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: I just want me and my lady is going to be here.

ctx.x: One girl, one girl, see, everybody got to have a couple, I mean a couple, see. Just like you would have a lady, you would have a lady with your dancing. And the one with the dance that slow drag the bass, we won the prize. You know, that's when my prize got soon. He used to be a good dancer too. We had a ball called 88, he wanted to throw around and show me that he beat me dancing. I was working painting, I stuck a piece of pine wood in my foot, it must have been about two weeks. A piece of what? Pound wood, I…
The umbrella was the prize. Yeah, the lady gets that, you don't get that.
